info.title: assieme-core
info.description: Terminal runtime for coding agents. JSON-RPC 2.0, one message per line on the asm socket (or framed after `hello`). Protocol generation 1. Errors carry a stable `data.kind`.

methods.name: terminal.wait
methods.description: Wait until the program is not working (any word but working, or it exited/was lost); already not working returns at once. A program that never reported status is working until it exits. After a send from the same caller, waits for the turn that send started. A message to the caller also ends it: ended false, reason message, from = sender. A timeout is a check-in: ended false, current status.

params.name: terminal

schema.description: The terminal; with `children`, whose children (default: the caller).

params.description: The terminal; with `children`, whose children (default: the caller).

params.name: children

schema.description:
Wait on children instead: all = until none is working, any = next news or a message to you.

`all`: until none of the children is working (one that hasn't reported
yet counts as working). `any`: the parent's unseen news (a turn ended, it
blocked, it hit an error, it exited), else the next child to stop working; for the parent
itself, also a message typed into it while it worked (reason `message`).
A child with a sent launch task counts as working until its turn advances
past delivery, or it reports done, blocked, error, or exits. Startup idle
does not complete that task in either mode. Without a launch task, idle
still counts as stopped.

params.description:

`all`: until none of the children is working (one that hasn't reported

A child with a sent launch task counts as working until its turn advances

error.description: Set when the file can't be used.
